exceptions.finding: The web client (index.html, admin.html, learning.html, course.html, served by kks_server) is served with no CSP, neither as a response header nor as a meta tag.
exceptions.reason: A CSP that restricts script-src needs the 91 inline event handlers (#18) and the inline <script> blocks moved to files first; a CSP sent before that breaks every page.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Every script is self-hosted (no page loads a script from another origin; vendor/ and the WebAssembly build are in the repository). The session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict, so an injected script can't read it. Every HTML sink is listed in #7 and escapes its values; the static-analysis job still reports each one as a warning, and the PR review rejects any new sink or inline handler.

exceptions.finding: 40 HTML sinks insert markup built from template literals, with values escaped by the project's own K.esc / esc instead of a maintained sanitizer (admin.html 18, index.html 12, common.js 9, learning.html 1). common.js:304 interpolates the join code unescaped (#16).
exceptions.reason: Moving every view to DOM building with textContent, or adding a maintained sanitizer with its dependency record, touches every page; it is planned file by file in #7, admin.html first.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Every interpolated text value goes through K.esc / esc (the one known raw value, the join code, is digits from this device's own core, #16). The static-analysis job reports every site in these files as a warning, so a new one shows in each PR, and the PR review rejects new sinks. No script from another origin runs on these pages, and the session cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict.

exceptions.finding: The Android app's Gradle build has no lockfile, so its transitive dependencies are neither pinned nor scanned.
exceptions.reason: Dependency locking changes the Android build and has to be checked against the release, rehearsal and debug builds and the e2e tests on the emulator; it is its own change (#3).
exceptions.compensatingControl: Every direct dependency and plugin has an exact version (the Compose BOM 2024.12.01 fixes the Compose versions; no ranges or dynamic versions), so the resolved tree only changes when a reviewed PR changes a version. Until the lockfile exists, each release audit lists the resolved tree (./gradlew :app2:dependencies) and checks it against OSV by hand.
